description:
## Why This Exists

post/mod.rs::find_header_boundary() uses two nested loops: the outer loop tries every position, and bytes.starts_with() scans up to 4 bytes. For articles without a blank-line separator (malformed), the outer loop runs n times. While the inner scan is bounded to 4 bytes, a missing-separator article causes n iterations of the outer loop. For normal articles this is fine. However, the same function is called 4-6 times per article in the POST pipeline (injection.rs, did_passthrough.rs, sign.rs, ipfs_write.rs, smtp_relay.rs) — each call rescans from the start.

## Acceptance Criteria

Cache the boundary offset in a wrapper, or pass the already-computed offset through the pipeline to avoid repeated O(n) scans.
title: find_header_boundary quadratic scan: O(n^2) on no-separator articles
